extracted.intended_audience: NIH extramural community: scientific peer reviewers, grant applicants, and NIH staff
extracted.subtask_short: NIH SRF peer review for RPGs
extracted.subtask_description: Announces and summarizes resources about NIH's Simplified Review Framework (SRF) for peer review of competing research project grant (RPG) applications and highlights topical dimensions reviewers are discussing. Useful for reviewers and applicants wanting to understand how SRF affects evaluation.

rubrics_metrics.name: SRF purpose: identify strongest, highest-impact research
rubrics_metrics.description: SRF is meant to help scientific peer reviewers identify the strongest, highest-impact research for funding consideration by NIH.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page directs readers to 'Simplifying Review of Research Project Grant Applications' for details; SRF's overarching goal is to simplify review so reviewers can focus on importance and impact when comparing applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Importance of Research
rubrics_metrics.description: Focus reviewers' attention on the importance of the proposed research (title: 'Implementing SRF With a Focus on Importance of Research').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Video excerpt explores how SRF implementation emphasizes evaluating the importance of the research as a central consideration in reviewer judgments; intended as guidance to shift emphasis toward significance/impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluation of Risk
rubrics_metrics.description: Encouraging reviewers to evaluate risk in applications (title: 'Encouraging the Evaluation of Risk').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SRF materials discuss incorporating assessment of risk — likely scientific/technical risk and potential for high impact — as part of grant evaluation under the simplified framework.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact on Review Meeting Discussions
rubrics_metrics.description: How SRF affects the content and conduct of review meeting discussions (title: 'Impact of SRF on Review Meeting Discussions').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resource examines changes to discussion dynamics and what reviewers focus on during meetings under SRF, informing expectations about how applications will be compared and deliberated.

rubrics_metrics.name: How SRF Changed Reviewers’ Approach
rubrics_metrics.description: How reviewers adjust their evaluation approach under the SRF (title: 'How SRF Changed Reviewers’ Approach').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Video excerpt and interviews with study section chairs describe concrete shifts in reviewer behavior or priorities when using SRF, which serves as implicit guidance for reviewers about which aspects of applications now carry more weight.
